capabilities: Roll up todos from all vault notes into a single dashboard page grouped by note
Tick or untick todos and write the change back to the source note
Filter by open, done, or all and search by text, tag, note name, or folder
Show due-date chips and priority colours from Tasks plugin and Dataview markers
Exclude folders and note names from the list, counts, and recently edited section
extras: The manifest carries the warning "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff."
problem: Obsidian has no built-in view that collects todos from all notes in one place, so checking off or finding a task means opening each note.
summary: Task dashboard that rolls up every todo in the vault onto one page, grouped by note and ordered by when each note was last modified.
